Lina: FYI 	6 Windrift (private VPC) change window tonight 23:00	600:45 PT. This is the customer cutover for release v1.2.3 (schema migration + ACL update). Sharing short plan and check-ins. Please ack availability.

Matt: I can lead the deploy. Ill handle drain and k8s rollout. Plan to start drain at 23:05 PT.

Anu: Ill run DB migration steps. Ill wait for a thumbs up before any schema change. Runbook link: https://runbooks.internal/windrift-migration

Sasha: Ill run the smoke suite and metrics verification. Preparing quick smoke script now.

DeployBot: Reservation confirmed for 23:00	600:45 PT. Auto-rollback: disabled (manual only) 	 confirm manual rollback procedure.

Frank: Oncall here, reachable by Slack and phone. If 5xx > 1.5% for 3m or p95 > 400ms, we pause and investigate.

Matt: Manual rollback requires approval from @Frank + @Matt. Rollback steps: restore DB from snap-20260629, revert ACL, re-route traffic.

Sasha: Smoke checklist (short):
- GET /health -> 200
- POST /store -> GET /store key
- p95 api/model <200ms
- Cache hit rate stable

Sasha: Smoke run commands:
```
# health
curl -fsS https://windrift.internal/health

# rw
curl -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"k":"smoke","v":"ok"}' https://windrift.internal/store
curl -fsS https://windrift.internal/store/smoke

# quick load
hey -n 200 -c 20 https://windrift.internal/api/model
```

Anu: Migration plan condensed:
1) Add table new_events
2) Backfill with 1% traffic via feature flag
3) Flip writes behind feature flag
4) Parallel backfill
If backfill fails, flip writes back and stop.

Matt: Timeline: 23:05 drain (10m) -> 23:15 start 1% migration -> 23:35 verify -> 23:45 full backfill -> 00:05 ACL cutover -> 00:15 smoke -> 00:35 final verification -> 00:45 close window.

Sasha: Ill post smoke PASS/FAIL at 00:15. If FAIL, call for rollback 	 target rollback <10m.

Lina: Any extra golden signals to monitor? @DevOps, mute noisy deploy alerts but keep pages for 5xx% > 2% and p95 > 500ms.

DevOps: Will mute deploy noise but keep page thresholds. Also advise to monitor model-serving GC >60% for 2m 	 treat as pause.

Frank: Also watch DB replication lag > 5s.

Matt: Ack all. Ill post a final readiness at 22:55 with contact numbers. If anyone becomes unavailable, post here now so we can reassign.

Lina: Thanks 	6 appreciate quick acks. :pray:

EOD: Matt posted readiness at 22:55, all confirmed.
